premises.evidence_span: There are so many of these things happening that they can't all be investigated

premises.text: A portable battery-powered instrument with lab-on-a-chip recirculation makes up to 100 simultaneous measurements from a single drop of saliva in under five minutes
premises.evidence_span: make up to 100 simultaneous measurements from a single drop of saliva

premises.evidence_span: we first launched in the forensic toxicology market, which has immediate need, high growth potential, and has minimal regulatory burden
